title: ArchMaker Common Definitions (v0)
description: Reusable $defs shared by the ArchMaker v0 data contracts: DEC-002 global identifiers, version axes, canonical units, digests, UTC timestamps, typed secret references, limits and the unknown-field policy. Semantic authority: docs/03-data/canonicalization-profile-v1.md (ADR-0007) and docs/00-governance/decision-register.md (DEC-002). Contract state: v0. Every using schema keeps additionalProperties:false; this file only contributes $defs and is never validated as a document root. Unknown properties are rejected at every object edge.
$comment: Contract v0 (phase R6, AUD-011). Stable $id: resolution is by $id, not by file path. See contracts/json-schema/CHANGELOG.md.

namespace.description: Global namespace with the DEC-002 vendor.kind shape.

shortId.description: Single-segment identifier used together with a namespace.

entityId.description: Global entity identifier with the DEC-002 vendor.kind.id shape.

capabilityId.description: Capability identifier such as fs.btrfs, gpu.nvidia or boot.uefi.

version.description: Generic version axis value (ADR-0006). Non-empty; exact per-axis format is delegated to axis-specific ADRs, so no semver is imposed here.

protocolVersion.description: Runner protocol version (axis protocolVersion), e.g. v1.

revision.description: Monotonic, non-negative document revision used as an optimistic-concurrency (ETag) token.

binary64.description: Finite IEEE-754 binary64 number (canonicalization profile decision 6). NaN, Infinities and values outside binary64 are rejected.

unitCode.description: Canonical unit code from the closed MVP vocabulary (canonicalization profile decision 7). Case-sensitive.

quantity.description: Canonical quantity {value, unit} (canonicalization profile decision 7). The unit is part of the hashed payload and is never converted during canonicalization.

digestKind.description: Digest class: content = semantic payload digest; artifact/binary = exact artifact bytes digest (canonicalization profile decision 11).

digest.description: Digest object. Role is conveyed by the property name; kind, when present, is the explicit class.

algorithm.description: Digest algorithm; only sha256 is defined.

contentDigest.description: Semantic content digest: SHA-256 of the canonical payload after profile steps 5 and 8 (canonicalization profile decision 11). Reproducible identity. When kind is present it must be 'content'.

artifactDigest.description: Binary artifact digest: SHA-256 of the exact exported bytes (canonicalization profile decision 11). When kind is present it must be 'artifact'.

binaryDigest.description: Binary digest: SHA-256 of exact bytes, never comparable with a contentDigest (canonicalization profile decision 11). When kind is present it must be 'binary'.

utcTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with a trailing Z. Ephemeral fields are excluded from the canonical hash payload (canonicalization profile decision 8).

ephemeralFieldName.description: Denylist of ephemeral/non-intentional fields removed recursively before canonical serialization (canonicalization profile decision 8). Not a validation keyword; declared for tooling parity.

secretReference.description: Opaque URI-style reference to a secret. The secret value is never serialized (THR-SEC-001); only this reference crosses CorePort.

secretRef.description: Typed secret reference object. Carries only the opaque reference; an inline secret value is not representable (additionalProperties:false).

jsonPointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; the empty string addresses the document root.

messageKey.description: Stable, localizable message key (not a free-form message).

severity.description: Canonical severity (errors-events.md is the single source of truth). fatal/debug are reserved and not used by the MVP.

limits.description: Resource limits applied before and during parsing. All bounds are optional; when a field is present it caps the corresponding dimension.

unknownFieldPolicy.description: Declared policy for unknown properties. Every ArchMaker v0 object rejects unknown fields (additionalProperties:false); compatibility is additive-only, so new fields require a schemaVersion bump.

catalogRef.description: Reference to an immutable catalog version.

targetRef.description: Reference to a versioned export adapter.

presetRef.description: Reference to an immutable preset patch.

selectionValue.description: Discriminated union SelectionValue (single, multiple, boolean, number, text, secretRef). The variant is exclusive via oneOf on the kind discriminator; secretRef never carries the secret.

optionIds.description: Selected option identifiers; ordered by ID before canonicalization (canonicalization profile decision 5).

selection.description: A single manual intent entry. The selected value lives only in value; there is no duplicated top-level optionId.

stepId.description: Catalog step the selection belongs to.

resolvedSelection.description: A frozen selection with its origin and lock state.

origin.description: Whether the selection was manual or derived.

locked.description: Whether the selection is locked by a rule or policy.

capabilityRef.description: Reference to a capability contributed or required.

conflict.description: A capability or selection conflict attached to a manifest.
